newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kroger Co raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kroger Co raised to buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it upgraded Kroger Co to buy from outperform.
-- said Kroger's competitive environment is beginning to stabilize, which would allow the company to reduce promotional spending and raise bottom-line profitability.
-- raised earnings estimate for 1997 to $3.30 a share from $3.23, and set a 1998 estimate of $3.85.
-- expects substantial free cash flow being generated in 1998 and 1999 that could be used to repay debt or repurchase stock.
